$comment: See adr/0001-artex-pinning.md. artex_git_sha is the authoritative pin; image_digest records what was actually built from it.
image_digest_note: Filled by `artexctl up` on first successful build; null means 'record me'. Switch image_ref to ghcr.io/pierce403/artex@sha256:... after the first v* tag push publishes the package.
